"'''Psycho'''" is a song by American musician [[Post Malone]] featuring American singer [[Ty Dolla Sign]]. It was released through [[Republic Records]] on February 23, 2018, as the third [[Single (music)|single]] from Malone's second studio album, ''[[Beerbongs & Bentleys]]'' (2018).<ref>{{cite news|last=Wicks|first=Amanda|title=Post Malone and Ty Dolla Sign Team for "Psycho": Listen|url=https://pitchfork.com/news/post-malone-and-ty-dolla-sign-team-for-psycho-listen/|access-date=February 23, 2018|work=Pitchfork|date=February 23, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Thiessen|first=Brock|title=Post Malone and Ty Dolla $ign Connect for "Psycho"|url=https://exclaim.ca/music/article/post_malone_and_ty_dolla_ign_connect_for_psycho|access-date=February 23, 2018|work=[[Exclaim!]]|date=February 23, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=New Music: Post Malone feat. Ty Dolla $ign – 'Psycho'|url=http://www.rap-up.com/2018/02/22/new-music-post-malone-ty-dolla-sign-psycho/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180223040334/http://www.rap-up.com/2018/02/22/new-music-post-malone-ty-dolla-sign-psycho/|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 23, 2018|access-date=February 23, 2018|work=[[Rap-Up]]|date=February 22, 2018}}</ref> The artists wrote the song with Carl Rosen and [[Louis Bell]], the latter producing it with Malone. Lyrically, the song discusses the artists' lifestyle and explores the theme of excessive fame and trust issues.<ref>{{cite news|last=Mastrogiannis|first=Nicole|title=Post Malone Teams Up With Ty Dolla $ign on New Song "Psycho"|url=https://channel955.iheart.com/content/2018-02-22-post-malone-teams-up-with-ty-dolla-ign-on-new-song-psycho/|access-date=February 23, 2018|work=[[iHeartRadio]]|date=February 23, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Wright|first=Hayden|title=Post Malone Drops 'Psycho' Featuring Ty Dolla $Ign: Listen|url=http://news.radio.com/2018/02/23/post-malone-psycho-ty-dolla-sign/|access-date=February 23, 2018|work=[[CBS Radio]]|date=February 23, 2018|archive-date=February 25, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180225234838/http://news.radio.com/2018/02/23/post-malone-psycho-ty-dolla-sign/|url-status=dead}}</ref> The song entered at number two on the US [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] behind [[Drake (musician)|Drake]]'s "[[God's Plan (song)|God's Plan]]",<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/pro/drake-gods-plan-post-malone-psycho-hot-100/|title=Drake's 'God's Plan' No. 1 on Billboard Hot 100 for Sixth Week, Post Malone's 'Psycho' Debuts at No. 2|magazine=Billboard|access-date=March 17, 2018}}</ref> and reached number one in June 2018, becoming Malone's second and Ty's first chart-topper.<ref name="Hot 100">{{cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/pro/post-malone-psycho-no-1-hot-100/|title=Post Malone's 'Psycho' Is No. 1 On The Hot 100|magazine=Billboard|last=Trust|first=Gary|date=June 11, 2018|access-date=June 12, 2018}}</ref>

"Psycho" is a song by American musician Post Malone featuring American singer Ty Dolla Sign. It was released through Republic Records on February 23, 2018, as the third single from Malone's second studio album, Beerbongs & Bentleys (2018). The artists wrote the song with Carl Rosen and Louis Bell, the latter producing it with Malone. Lyrically, the song discusses the artists' lifestyle and explores the theme of excessive fame and trust issues. The song entered at number two on the US Billboard Hot 100 behind Drake's "God's Plan", and reached number one in June 2018, becoming Malone's second and Ty's first chart-topper.

sections.heading: Release and promotion
sections.wikitext: Malone first teased the song on January 4, 2017, with a video of him playing the song in a studio.<ref>{{cite news|last=DeVille|first=Chris|title=Post Malone – "Psycho" (Feat. Ty Dolla $ign)|url=https://www.stereogum.com/1984347/post-malone-psycho-feat-ty-dolla-ign/music/|access-date=February 23, 2018|work=[[Stereogum]]|date=February 23, 2018}}</ref> Over a year later on February 21, 2018, he previewed the song on Twitter with a 30-second snippet,<ref>{{cite news|last=Schmitt|first=Tyler|title=Post Malone Teams Up with Ty Dolla $ign for New Song 'Psycho'|url=http://variancemagazine.com/sounds/8968-post-malone-psycho-featuring-ty-dolla-sign|access-date=February 27, 2018|work=[[Variance (magazine)|Variance]]|date=February 23, 2018}}</ref> which highlights his verse.<ref>{{cite magazine|last=Lamarre|first=Carl|title=Post Malone Teases Ty Dolla $ign-Assisted Track 'Psycho' on Twitter|url=https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/post-malone-teases-new-song-psycho-ty-dolla-sign-8214675/|access-date=February 23, 2018|magazine=Billboard|date=February 22, 2018}}</ref> The accompanying artwork features a wolf and a [[bulldozer]], the latter of which has the words "Posty Co." scribed on it.<ref>{{cite news|last=Berry|first=Peter|title=Post Malone Previews New Song "Psycho" Featuring Ty Dolla Sign|url=http://www.xxlmag.com/video/2018/02/post-malone-psycho-ty-dolla-sign/|access-date=February 23, 2018|work=[[XXL (magazine)|XXL]]|date=February 21, 2018}}</ref> The song comes with its own merch line, featuring three different long sleeve [[T-shirt]]s.<ref>{{cite news|last=Krastz|first=Roger|title=Post Malone Releases "Psycho" Merchandise|url=http://www.xxlmag.com/lifestyle/2018/02/post-malone-releases-psycho-merchandise/|access-date=February 27, 2018|work=XXL|date=February 26, 2018}}</ref>
sections.text: Malone first teased the song on January 4, 2017, with a video of him playing the song in a studio. Over a year later on February 21, 2018, he previewed the song on Twitter with a 30-second snippet, which highlights his verse. The accompanying artwork features a wolf and a bulldozer, the latter of which has the words "Posty Co." scribed on it. The song comes with its own merch line, featuring three different long sleeve T-shirts.

sections.heading: Composition
sections.wikitext: According to ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' and ''[[Spin (magazine)|Spin]]'', the song has a slow-moving [[Trap music|trap]] beat and melodically bears a resemblance to Post Malone's 2015 song "[[White Iverson]]".<ref name="Kenney">{{cite magazine|last=Kenney|first=Kevan|title=Post Malone & Ty Dolla $ign Drop New Song 'Psycho'|url=https://www.billboard.com/video/bbnews022318postmalone-8215379|access-date=February 27, 2018|magazine=Billboard|date=February 23, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Arcand|first=Rob|title=Post Malone – "Psycho" ft. Ty Dolla $ign|url=https://www.spin.com/2018/02/post-malone-psycho-ft-ty-dolla-ign/|access-date=February 23, 2018|work=Spin|date=February 23, 2018}}</ref> The lyrics contain a reference to [[Leon DeChino]], a musical alias Malone used in high school.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Morel Jr. |first1=Jacques |last2=Hill |first2=Tia |author3=Oppi |last4=Brown |first4=Lisa |date=April 4, 2018 |title=The Story Behind Post Malone's Alter Ego Leon DeChino |work=[[Genius (company)|Genius]] |url=https://genius.com/a/the-story-behind-post-malone-s-alter-ego-leon-dechino |access-date=July 23, 2023}}</ref>
sections.text: According to Billboard and Spin, the song has a slow-moving trap beat and melodically bears a resemblance to Post Malone's 2015 song "White Iverson". The lyrics contain a reference to Leon DeChino, a musical alias Malone used in high school.

sections.heading: Critical reception
sections.wikitext: Sheldon Pearce of ''[[Pitchfork (website)|Pitchfork]]'' deemed the song a combination of "some of the least interesting raps you could possibly imagine" and "a downer that won't quit", writing that it "uses concepts that have been played out in hip-hop for years".<ref>{{cite news|last=Pearce|first=Sheldon|title="Psycho" [ft. Ty Dolla $ign] by Post Malone Review|url=https://pitchfork.com/reviews/tracks/post-malone-psycho-ft-ty-dolla-dollarign/|access-date=February 27, 2018|work=Pitchfork|date=February 23, 2018}}</ref> Patrick Hosken of [[MTV News]] opined that the song "finds a late-night vibe that, away from the madness of crunching guitars, unfolds like a chill celebration of luxury".<ref>{{cite news|last=Hosken|first=Patrick|title=Post Malone Teams Up With Ty Dolla $ign To Recount Their Many Luxuries On 'Psycho'|url=http://www.mtv.com/news/3066106/post-malone-ty-dolla-sign-psycho/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180223184505/http://www.mtv.com/news/3066106/post-malone-ty-dolla-sign-psycho/|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 23, 2018|access-date=February 27, 2018|work=MTV News|date=February 23, 2018}}</ref> Mitch Findlay of HotNewHipHop wrote that it "continues the formula set by" Post Malone's previous single "[[Rockstar (Post Malone song)|Rockstar]]", and that they share "a few melodic similarities", describing "Psycho" as "more subdued" in comparison.<ref>{{cite news|last=Findlay|first=Mitch|title=Post Malone & Ty Dolla $ign Connect On "Psycho"|url=https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/81834-post-malone-and-ty-dolla-sign-connect-on-psycho-new-song|access-date=February 23, 2018|work=HotNewHipHop|date=February 22, 2018}}</ref> The track was named the worst song of 2018 by ''[[Time (magazine)|Time]]''.<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://time.com/5475647/worst-songs-2018/|title=The 10 Worst Songs of 2018|magazine=Time}}</ref>
sections.text: Sheldon Pearce of Pitchfork deemed the song a combination of "some of the least interesting raps you could possibly imagine" and "a downer that won't quit", writing that it "uses concepts that have been played out in hip-hop for years". Patrick Hosken of MTV News opined that the song "finds a late-night vibe that, away from the madness of crunching guitars, unfolds like a chill celebration of luxury". Mitch Findlay of HotNewHipHop wrote that it "continues the formula set by" Post Malone's previous single "Rockstar", and that they share "a few melodic similarities", describing "Psycho" as "more subdued" in comparison. The track was named the worst song of 2018 by Time.

sections.heading: Music video
sections.wikitext: The official music video for "Psycho" was released on March 22, 2018, on Post Malone's [[Vevo]] YouTube channel. It was directed by James DeFina.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=au2n7VVGv_c|title=Post Malone – Psycho ft. Ty Dolla $ign|via=YouTube|date=March 22, 2018}}</ref> It features Malone riding on a [[FV103 Spartan]] [[Armoured personnel carrier|armored personnel carrier]], in what appears to be a post apocalyptic world. Before fighting a wolf with a [[flamethrower]] when trying to rescue a homeless little girl. While Ty is revealed to be inside of the tank, and gets out with Malone amidst the wreckage of ruined aircraft.
sections.text: The official music video for "Psycho" was released on March 22, 2018, on Post Malone's Vevo YouTube channel. It was directed by James DeFina. It features Malone riding on a FV103 Spartan armored personnel carrier, in what appears to be a post apocalyptic world. Before fighting a wolf with a flamethrower when trying to rescue a homeless little girl. While Ty is revealed to be inside of the tank, and gets out with Malone amidst the wreckage of ruined aircraft.
